_notes: _notes is not part of the manifest: drop it when merging.
PROPOSED v4 additions to manifest.json for OAIY's setup wizard: a fragment for the host side to merge once OAIY reads v4.
manifest.json stays schemaVersion 3 until then: a v4 manifest would stop the plugin loading on today's host.

modules: the shape OAIY's modules code reads ({"provides": [...]}). Aokie's connector declares every command a phone claim needs (phone.status, sms.send, settings.get, settings.set, call.dial); the calendar needs none.

setup.steps[].done: the host re-checks this itself; PluginHost.setup.done() from the screen is only a hint to check now. The check shape here ({command, path, equals} or {command, all: [...]}) is a proposal; the host defines the final one.

Every done/when command is read-only, not journalled (not in commands.journalled), and must be sent with NO payload: dongle.diagnostics with {"simulate": "call"} runs a simulated call in dev mode. A command that rejects (no radio, plugin restarting) means not done.

consent: consent.get returns `grant` even when it is an old version or expired, and bluetooth.allowed is true in warn/off mode with no grant, so the check is enforce mode AND bluetooth.allowed AND nothing blocking the radio for consent. In dev mode (FORMLOGIC_DEV_MODE=1) the mode is always "off", so this step never checks done there.

dongle: radio.connected is the PHONE's link (set at ACL connection), not the dongle's; the dongle is ready when radio.initialized is true (the controller answered, aokie.dongle.ready). dongle.diagnostics rejects while no radio exists. On the built-in Windows Bluetooth transport (settings.transportMode native or auto) there is no dongle and radio.initialized only turns true once a phone connects, so the step is skipped there (`when`).

pair: phone.status.paired is true as soon as a phone's link is up (ACL connection complete), which is a beat BEFORE the numeric comparison of a new pairing, and without a radio it reports the saved config. The check is a live connection with no pairing window and no comparison open; `connected` is absent without a radio.

The screen (ui/receptionist, setup mode) shows the tab for `view` and calls PluginHost.setup.done() on the same conditions, plus: consent also needs every configured destination covered; pair also needs the connected phone in phone.listPaired.
